cases.name: Rosa Delina Reyes
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Born in Usulutan, El Salvador on October 25, 1965, she was one of 12 children born to the late Teodula Reyes and Juan Francisco Martinez. She was raised and educated in El Salvador. In the 1980’s, she moved to New York, and later moved to Pennsylvania where she worked at the Benton Foundry for many years.
